# Update 2.0.0 - [Short subtitle]

[1-2 sentence summary of the release.]

## Upgrading

* Update from 2.0.0-RC6.
* Addons: `PluginBootstrappedEvent`, `PluginReadyEvent`, `PluginInitializedEvent` and `PluginShutdownEvent` were removed; `PluginReloadedEvent` is now called after `/socialismus reload` and can no longer be cancelled. Rebuild what your addon derives from Socialismus documents on it.
* The configuration has one document per topic now: `updater.yml` is split out of `settings.yml`, the command behaviour moves to `commands.yml`, and the chat documents and chats move from `chats/` to `chat/`, with the chats in `chat/list/`. The first start moves every value you changed and backs up each file it touches to `.strata/backup/`; nothing to do by hand.
* Settings renamed on the way: `misc.disableJoinNotification` and `misc.disableQuitNotification` become `vanilla.joinMessage` and `vanilla.quitMessage`, which say whether the message is shown; `misc.vanillaSending` becomes `vanilla.sending`; the unused `misc.allowLegacyParsing` is removed; `updater.interval` is a duration such as `"1h"`.
* Addons: `Settings` no longer holds the updater and command settings; read the `Updater` and `Commands` documents instead.
* Addons: resources are named by typed `ResourceKey`s instead of `ResourceType`; a module defines its own. `ResourceProvider` returns `ProvidedResource`s, `ResourceRegistry.register` reports `KEY_TAKEN` instead of keeping the first resource silently, and `ResourceRegisteredEvent` and `ResourceUnregisteredEvent` announce each change. Modules no longer list required resources; a module that needs another one's resource depends on that module.
* Addons: Socialismus no longer has a database resource or `DatabaseService`; the database is SocialismusDatabase's, with its own API.
* Private messages moved out of Essentials into the new Dialogue module: install the Dialogue jar for `/msg` and `/reply`; Essentials no longer ships. Dialogue starts with its own files in `modules/dialogue/`, so set again what you changed in `modules/Essentials/features/dialogue/`.
* Requirements are written as `requires:` lists now, read by Conditia: a chat's `requirements: {SENDER, RECIPIENT}` groups become `requires` (who may write) and `reaches` (who receives it), a format's become `requires`, chat history's `permission` and `bypassPermission` become `history.requires` and `history.bypass`, and `toggle.bypass` is a list too; Bubbler, Chirper and Dialogue changed the same way. RC6's requirement groups are not carried over: the first start drops them, so a chat that RC6 kept to a permission, such as `local`, is open to everyone until you write its lists again; delete the `requirements:` blocks left in `chat/list/`, which no longer do anything. The Requirements page of the configuration documentation shows the new form, such as `- permission: socialismus.chat.local`.
* What a refused player is told moved into the new `phrases.yml`, keyed by reason, such as `denied.permission.missing` or `chat.denied.world.inside`, and Dialogue's into `modules/dialogue/phrases.yml` under `dialogue.denied.sender` and `dialogue.denied.recipient`; the `requirements` texts of `messages.yml`, `chat/messages.yml` and Dialogue's messages are gone, so set again what you changed there. A line of a `requires:` list can carry its own `denied` text and a `hint`, and refer to a phrase of yours as `<ref:key>`; a reference no phrases file has stops the start with its path.
* A chat trigger's `radius` and a bubble's `display.radius` are gone: how far a chat or a bubble reaches is a condition of its `reaches` now, `- nearby: <blocks>`, and on a proxy, which knows no positions, `- same: server`. A chat that reached different distances by trigger becomes one chat per distance. The radius is not carried over: write `nearby` into the `reaches` of each chat and bubble that had one, such as `local`, or it reaches everyone. New conditions beside it: `same` (the sender's world, server, or a placeholder's value, for town or team chats), `sees` (leaves out a sender a vanish plugin hides) and `language` (the player's game language).
* `notifications.noPlayers` and `noNearbyPlayers` of `chat/settings.yml` become `notifications.nobody`, and their texts in `chat/messages.yml` are gone: a message that reaches nobody tells its sender why, in the `chat.denied.recipient` phrases of `phrases.yml`, such as `nearby.outside`, or in `chat.nobody`. Turn `nobody` on again if you had either on.
* Addons: `ChatRequirementService.reaches` returns the `Verdict` instead of a boolean, and `ChatTrigger.getRadius()`, `Bubble.Display.getRadius()`, `ChatSettings.Notifications.isNoPlayers()`, `isNoNearbyPlayers()` and `ChatMessages.getNoPlayers()`, `getNoNearbyPlayers()` are removed.
* A list that names an unknown condition, part or setting stops the start with its path, such as `chats.staff.requires[0].permission`, instead of denying everyone while the server runs; after `/socialismus reload` the console names the list and the previous one stays in use.
* Addons: `RequirementGroup`, `Requirement`, its types, `RequirementEvaluatorService`, `RequirementValidation` and their registry are removed. A module registers Conditia condition types through `ModuleContext.conditions()`, named `<module id>:<name>`, checks its own lists through Socialismus's `Conditions` with the parts of `RequirementParts`, and `RequirementTexts.denied(failed, scope, placeholders)` words a `Verdict.Failed` as a `Phrase` from the line's `denied` and `hint` and the phrases of the scope; `Phrasebook` finds and renders phrases for any feature, and a module adds its own `phrases.yml` through `Phrasebook.add` and `PhrasesConfigProvider`.
* Each module keeps its files in a folder named after its id now: `modules/bubbler/`, `modules/chirper/`, `modules/dialogue/`, `modules/essentials/`, `modules/socialismus-network/`, `modules/socialismus-redis/`, `modules/socialismus-channelizer/`, `modules/socialismus-link/` and `modules/socialismus-database/`. Nothing is moved for you: before the first start, rename each module's folder, such as `modules/SocialismusNetwork/` to `modules/socialismus-network/`, or the module starts with new files. Update every module jar together with Socialismus; modules built for an earlier release candidate do not load.
* Addons: modules are Chassis extensions now. A module's descriptor is `module.yml` instead of `module.json`, with an `id` (lowercase with hyphens) beside its `name`, a `host` range of Socialismus versions such as `">=2.0.0-rc.7"` instead of the `socialismus` pattern, `platforms` as `{name: paper, version: ">=1.16 <1.22"}`, other modules in `dependencies` by id, an integration of Socialismus in `requires`, such as `packetevents: "*"`, and a plugin whose classes it uses in `peers`, with the packages it uses. The main class implements `SocialisticModule` with `enable(ModuleContext)` and `disable()` instead of extending it with four methods; `ModuleContext` gives its folder, logger and library groups (`libraries().load(...)`). `ModuleService` is replaced by Chassis's `Extensions`. Socialismus's version reads `2.0.0-rc.7` for a module's range, so pre-releases order by number; the developer documentation's "Writing a module" shows a whole module.
* Synchronization moved out of Socialismus into the new SocialismusNetwork module: on every server or proxy that should share chat, players and private messages, install SocialismusNetwork together with SocialismusRedis or SocialismusChannelizer, which are now its transports. Socialismus no longer reads `sync.yml` and `chat/sync.yml`; SocialismusNetwork takes them over on its first start (the server's name becomes its `node`) and removes them. On a server without SocialismusNetwork you may delete them.
* Addons: Socialismus no longer holds `SyncService`, `CacheService`, `SyncedSocialismusPlayer`, `ChatSyncBus`, `ChatHistorySyncBus`, the `Sync` and `ChatSync` documents, `Constants.Synchronization`, `Constants.Channels` and `Constants.Resources`; use SocialismusNetwork's API (`NetworkService`, replicated caches and channels, leases) instead. `ChatMessage.getOrigin()` is replaced by `isRelayed()` and typed attributes (`getAttribute(AttributeKey)`), where SocialismusNetwork sets `NetworkAttributes.ORIGIN`; `ChatHistoryRemoveEvent` carries no origin. New extension points: `ChatCoordinationService.relay`, `PlayerSource` through `PlayerRegistry.addSource`, and `ChatOwnership` through `ChatOwnershipService`.
* The Velocity build now needs Velocity 4.x and Java 25 or newer, because it is built against the Velocity API of 4.x and no longer loads on Velocity 3.x. Update Velocity and the Java your proxy runs on before you update Socialismus there.
* The Bukkit build now runs from Minecraft 1.16.5 on Java 11 or newer, on Spigot and on Paper; on Paper below 1.20.6, which the Paper build needs together with Java 21, install it instead of the Paper build.
* `messages.yml` holds only texts now. The help's settings move to the `behavior` block of `commands.yml`: `commands.help.commandsPerPage` becomes `behavior.help.commandsPerPage`, and `commands.pagination.showPaginationIfOnePage`, `showPreviousEvenIfFirst` and `showNextEvenIfLast` become `behavior.pagination.showIfOnePage`, `showPreviousOnFirst` and `showNextOnLast`. They are not carried over: set them again if you changed them.
* The help's texts in `messages.yml` are written anew and start from their defaults: `commands.help` holds `title` (`{host}`), `command` (`{command}`, `{arguments}`, `{description}`), `argument` and `optionalArgument` (`{name}`) and `empty`, and `commands.pagination` holds `line` (`{current}`, `{max}`, `{previous}`, `{next}`), `previous` and `next` (`{page}`). The arrows open their page themselves, so they need no click tag. The argument templates of command usages are `commands.format.argument` and `optionalArgument`, with `{argument}`.
